criteria.detail: monthly changes: 3 of 3 shifts reach enough of the 69795 rows to be fitted, 3 of them over at least as many clusters as the fit has coefficients; levels: 3 of 3 shifts reach enough of the 80117 rows to be fitted, 3 of them over at least as many clusters as the fit has coefficients. Each fitted shift runs the real branch series and the shifted one on exactly the rows that shift reaches, so the two standard errors share a sample and a cluster count. A cluster-robust meat matrix is a sum of one outer product per cluster, so with fewer clusters than coefficients it is singular and its standard errors carry nothing; that is arithmetic and not a threshold. An arm with no surviving shift has no floor, and its reading below is not adjudicable rather than failed

criteria.detail: dev and dev_state both subtract nat(t), so they correlate through var(nat) even under independence. corr(dev, dev_state) is 0.7260 raw, 0.7086 under a day fixed effect which absorbs nat(t) exactly, and 0.3773 with a market effect added. The regressions use the absorbed form. corr(dev, log arrivals) is -0.0799 raw and 0.0145 absorbed

criteria.name: B61-4  the rival's regressor: does the deviation load on the region's own conditions
criteria.rival_entailment: If the field is generated that way then, once the day's national level and the market's fixed position are held out, a market's deviation is explained by its own supply conditions, and the identity of the intermediary carries no further information. So the coefficient on the market's own arrivals has to clear a floor built by shifting the intermediary series, and the coefficient on the intermediary must not.
criteria.rival_premise: A distance-weighted equilibrium: the value at a position is set by that position's own conditions and its distance from the anchor. This is the branch B30-5 names in as many words, 'loads on local conditions -> the field is an equilibrium'.

criteria.detail: 80117 rows come from 291 markets in 9 states over 3283 days, and no count in this record is an independent-observation count. Standard errors are clustered on the state, which is the level the branch varies at; the iid figure is in every fit beside the clustered one. The three commodities are downstream of one market system, so a replication across them is not three independent samples
criteria.name: B61-6  what the counts are not
